g.text: LP losses to snipers, by sequencer ordering rule

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #8d8b86

g.text: Mean over 200 seeds per point, bands are 95% bootstrap intervals. 3 snipers, sniper latency 0.5× the LP's. At B = 0 the three rules order identically.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #8d8b86

g.text: Unit: bps of the span's volume, not dollars (dollars are in headline_b250.csv). Under PGA each sniper bids 0.1× the prize it sees; the LP does not bid.
